# Joins and Relational Thinking {#sec-joins-relational-thinking}

## Learning objectives

- Choose between inner and outer joins from the analytical question.
- Predict how table grain and key uniqueness affect row counts.
- Detect accidental many-to-many joins before they corrupt results.

## Supporting example

The case-study join in `scripts/sql/04-joins.sql` combines orders, customers, order items, and products while preserving order-item grain.
